In the reverse direction, action-informed agentic refinement exposes generated action chunks and calibrated camera reprojections back to the agent, allowing it to diagnose spatial discrepancies, revise targets for subsequent VLA calls, or locally adjust motion segments on top of the guided trajectory. Making the VLA controllable not only boosts online agentic tool use, but also unlocks effective recursive self-improvement (RSI), achieving state-of-the-art performance of 99.4\% on LIBERO-Plus, 48.62\% on RoboDojo, and 89.4\% on RoboCasa365. Project page: https://lingwupro.github.io/InteractVLA/.
embodied.titleZh: InteractVLA：将VLA转化为面向智能体式机器人操作的可交互工具
embodied.summaryZh: 现有智能体式操作把预训练VLA策略当作只接受语言指令的黑箱原语，当指令陌生或场景扰动导致调用失败时，智能体只能反复重试或人工接管。InteractVLA在VLA与视觉语言智能体之间建立双向几何接口：前向用可微的指令到位姿映射，经动作专家把智能体指定的末端目标转成输入梯度，实现测试时几何引导，并以软时间对齐把到达时刻作为隐执行索引；反向把动作块与标定相机重投影回传，供智能体诊断空间偏差、修正后续目标或局部调整轨迹。该机制支撑递归自我改进，在LIBERO-Plus、RoboDojo、RoboCasa365分别取得99.4%、48.62%、89.4%。
embodied.reason: 把VLA做成智能体可检查、可引导的工具，方法新颖且指标强

embodied.title: RoboTeam: Benchmarking Vision-Based Multi-Agent Control of Many Robot Arms in Real Time
embodied.abstract: Multimodal agents can now control robot arms by calling tools and writing code. Existing benchmarks fall short in three ways: most test one or two arms on short tasks, many pause the world while the agent thinks, and many give it ground-truth object positions. We present RoboTeam, a simulated benchmark where agents control 4 to 16 robot arms in real time from camera images alone. Its 36 tasks are long jobs that the arms must do together, such as passing timbers or building a picture from hundreds of cubes. We start from the most flexible agent system, the adaptive system, where one agent decides when to fork delegates. With it, gpt-6.1-sol and opus-5.5 complete 28 and 27 tasks, and four other models at most 3. But at a high price: a typical task takes gpt-6.1-sol 3.5 hours and 218 million input tokens, and a third of its steps fail at least once and must be retried. We then compare it with three fixed systems: single-agent, hierarchical, and decentralized. All four complete a similar number of tasks but differ in time and tokens. The hierarchical and decentralized systems are faster but use up to 1.9 times the tokens, and the single agent uses fewer tokens but takes 1.6 times as long, so the adaptive system lies between them. Even so, no model or system is yet fast, cheap, and reliable at once. RoboTeam measures these limits where earlier benchmarks cannot: long multi-arm jobs, camera images only, and a world that never pauses.
embodied.titleZh: RoboTeam：实时多机械臂视觉多智能体控制的基准测试
embodied.summaryZh: 现有具身智能体基准多为单臂或双臂、短任务、推理时暂停世界，且常提供物体真值坐标，难以衡量多机协作的真实难度。RoboTeam 构建仿真基准:智能体仅凭相机图像，实时控制4至16台机械臂完成36个长时程协作任务(如传递木料、用数百个方块拼图)，并对比自适应分叉、单智能体、分层、去中心化四种系统架构。gpt-6.1-sol与opus-5.5分别完成28与27个任务，其余四个模型最多完成3个;但代价高昂，典型任务耗时3.5小时、消耗2.18亿输入token，约三分之一步骤至少失败一次需重试。该基准揭示了当前模型与架构尚无法同时做到快速、廉价、可靠，为多智能体具身控制提供了更贴近真实约束的评测。
embodied.reason: 多机械臂视觉智能体基准，实时不暂停世界，直接命中具身评测与智能体方向

embodied.title: LoRN: Low-Rank Noise Steering for Generative Robot Policies
embodied.abstract: Noise steering improves pretrained generative robot policies by learning to select their initial noise without updating model weights. We find that actions in the evaluated world-action models are more sensitive to video noise than action noise, making video noise an expressive input for steering. However, the noise-steering methods we evaluate, in their published forms, struggle to scale to the high-dimensional noise inputs of large policy classes such as world-action models. We introduce Low-Rank Noise Steering (LoRN), a reinforcement learning method that scales noise steering to world-action models. A small steering actor selects a direction through a fixed low-rank random projection, while our norm-controlled construction keeps the resulting noise near the typical scale of a Gaussian sample. This separates the actor's control dimension from the full noise dimension, enabling steering of both video and action inputs. Across three world-action models and ten model-task pairs, video steering improves average success by 26.2 percentage points over the base policy, compared with 7.1 points for DSRL action steering. For smaller action policies, the same construction achieves comparable final success while generally improving early-training success. Steering actors trained in simulation also transfer to three physical bimanual manipulation tasks across two base policies, without additional real-world training.
embodied.titleZh: LoRN：面向生成式机器人策略的低秩噪声引导
embodied.summaryZh: 生成式机器人策略可通过选择初始噪声来提升表现，但现有噪声引导方法难以扩展到世界-动作模型的高维噪声输入。LoRN用小型引导actor在固定低秩随机投影上选择方向，并通过范数控制使噪声保持在高斯样本的典型尺度，从而把控制维度与完整噪声维度解耦，同时引导视频噪声与动作噪声。在三个世界-动作模型、十组模型-任务对上，视频引导相对基座策略平均成功率提升26.2个百分点，DSRL动作引导仅提升7.1个百分点；仿真训练的引导actor无需额外真实训练即可迁移到两个基座策略下的三个真实双臂操作任务。
embodied.reason: 面向世界-动作模型的噪声引导RL，方法扎实且有真机迁移

embodied.title: How Uncertain Is My Action? Self-Correcting Visual Planning with Frozen World Models
embodied.abstract: A frozen latent world model combined with sampling-based model predictive control is a visual planner. At deployment, the executed action can depart from the commanded one, and the frozen model has no way to notice. We show that the model can be run in reverse: for any hypothesized actuation shift, it predicts what it should have observed under that shift, and comparing this prediction with what was actually observed quantifies the shift and lets the planner correct itself. Unlike the residual energy, which mixes the shift with the model's own error, the score keeps only the part of the residual that a shift can produce. This shift score detects the shift with a locally optimal test, estimates it with Cramer-Rao error bars, names the dominant generator, and compensates the planner once an alarm fires. On PushT, TwoRoom and OGBench-Cube with a frozen latent world model, measured detection follows the prediction to within 0.05 AUROC. Self-correction raises success from 0.650 to 0.862 on PushT and from 0.378 to 0.432 on the harder Cube task, levels with an oracle that is told the true shift at the same block, better than five common test-time adaptation methods. On a real robotic arm, the score identifies a base-joint offset that no joint encoder registers and reduces the reach error from 36 mm to 3-5 mm, and under shifts drawn at random and sealed before the session, estimates recover 92-94% of the error reduction achieved with the true shift. The broader implication is that a frozen world model can act as a filter by predicting the future, testing action-interface uncertainty and validity, and finally correcting failures.
embodied.titleZh: 我的动作有多不确定？用冻结世界模型做自校正视觉规划
embodied.summaryZh: 部署时执行动作会偏离指令，而冻结的潜世界模型无法察觉这种偏移。做法是把世界模型反向运行：对任一假设的执行偏移预测本应观测到的结果，再与真实观测比较，得到只保留「偏移能产生的那部分残差」的 shift score，从而以局部最优检验检测偏移、用 Cramer-Rao 界给出误差条、定位主导偏移来源，并在报警后补偿规划器。在 PushT、TwoRoom、OGBench-Cube 上，检测 AUROC 与理论预测相差 0.05 以内，自校正把 PushT 成功率从 0.650 提升到 0.862、Cube 从 0.378 提升到 0.432，与被告知真实偏移的 oracle 持平并优于五种测试时自适应方法；真机上识别出关节编码器未登记的基座关节偏移，把 reach 误差从 36 mm 降到 3–5 mm，随机密封偏移下恢复 92–94% 的误差削减量。这说明冻结世界模型可充当滤波器：预测未来、检验动作接口的不确定性与有效性，并最终纠正失败。
embodied.reason: 冻结世界模型做执行偏移自检与自校正，含真机验证，命中世界模型规划方向

embodied.title: RageVLA: Augmentation-Trained Perception and Action for State-of-the-Art Robustness on LIBERO
embodied.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models look saturated on LIBERO, yet most of them fall apart on LIBERO-PRO as soon as an object moves or the instruction asks for something new. We argue that what is missing is not scale but decoupling. In these policies, what to do is tied to where things were during training, to the scene around them and to the wording of the instruction. We cut these ties in two places. In the data, LIBERO demonstrations are re-arranged by general rules: every object and fixture is moved and rotated, tasks are carried into other environments and onto other surfaces, and every instruction is paraphrased. In the policy, a perception engine on frozen DINOv3 features, trained on this augmented data, hands the action model the scene in decoupled form: a list of objects with their positions, and a compact code of what the gripper is looking at, next to image and instruction embeddings from TinyCLIP. A flow-matching diffusion transformer, trained from scratch, acts on this view. We call this combination of Robust Augmentation and Grounded Encoding RageVLA. With 0.21 billion parameters, RageVLA sets a new state of the art on LIBERO-PRO among VLA policies, scoring 0.72 against 0.53 for the best published model, and a larger variant reaches 0.73. Two further tests on LIBERO-Object show that the policy acts on what it perceives. When the object positions it is given are shuffled while the camera images stay correct, its success falls from 0.965 to 0.215. When the target object is displaced by 28 cm, it still succeeds in 0.865 of the episodes, where $π_{0.5}$, run through the same harness, succeeds in 0.105.
embodied.titleZh: RageVLA：以增强训练感知与动作，在LIBERO上取得最先进的鲁棒性
embodied.summaryZh: VLA模型在LIBERO上已趋饱和，但物体移动或指令改写后在LIBERO-PRO上普遍失效；问题不在规模而在耦合。RageVLA从数据与策略两侧解耦：数据侧按通用规则重排演示，移动旋转物体与场景固定件、迁移到其他环境与台面、改写指令；策略侧用冻结DINOv3特征训练感知引擎，输出物体位置列表与夹爪注视对象的紧凑编码，连同TinyCLIP的图像与指令嵌入送入从零训练的流匹配扩散Transformer。0.21B参数在LIBERO-PRO上达0.72，超过最佳已发表模型的0.53；打乱物体位置而图像不变时成功率由0.965跌至0.215，目标偏移28cm仍有0.865。
embodied.reason: VLA感知与动作解耦，鲁棒性提升有数据支撑，正中VLA训练方向

embodied.title: TCP4D: A Unified Tool-Center-Point Tracking and Generation Model for Robot Manipulation
embodied.abstract: Robot manipulation videos provide a rich visual experience, yet recovering robot action and gripper-state annotations from RGB observations still remains challenging. Using the embodiment-agnostic tool-center-point (TCP) pose as the action space, we present TCP4D, a unified model in which a shared 4D scene representation both tracks observed TCP motion and generates future TCP trajectories. Given a monocular video and initial 2D TCP queries, the tracker directly recovers metric TCP poses in SE(3) and gripper states alongside scene geometry and camera parameters. The generator samples local features from the same 4D representation along the recovered TCP tracks, then combines them with robot observations and language instructions to predict future TCP states. Our new cross-embodiment augmentation pipeline converts existing RGB videos into demonstrations for alternative embodiments by retargeting the recovered motion and synthesizing the corresponding observations, without recorded source-robot states. Experiments show that the tracker achieves absolute trajectory errors of 7.60 and 16.07 mm on DROID and RoboLab and adapts to a new embodiment with only ten demonstrations. The generator achieves 69.19% mean success on RoboTwin and outperforms well-established policy models on two real-world tasks, while joint training on source and augmented demonstrations improves target-robot success by 41.5% over augmented-only training.
embodied.titleZh: TCP4D:面向机器人操作的工具中心点跟踪与生成统一模型
embodied.summaryZh: 从RGB视频中恢复机器人动作与夹爪状态标注仍然困难。该工作以与本体无关的工具中心点(TCP)位姿为动作空间，构建统一模型:共享的4D场景表示既跟踪观测到的TCP运动，又生成未来TCP轨迹;跟踪器从单目视频与初始2D TCP查询直接回归SE(3)度量位姿、夹爪状态、场景几何与相机参数，生成器沿恢复轨迹采样局部特征并结合机器人观测与语言指令预测未来TCP状态;配套的跨本体增强管线通过重定向恢复运动并合成观测，将现有RGB视频转为其他本体的演示。跟踪器在DROID与RoboLab上的绝对轨迹误差为7.60 mm与16.07 mm，仅需10条演示即可适配新本体;生成器在RoboTwin上平均成功率69.19%，在两个真机任务上优于成熟策略模型，源数据与增强数据联合训练比仅用增强数据提升目标机器人成功率41.5%。
embodied.reason: 统一TCP动作空间的跟踪与生成，跨本体数据增强，命中VLA动作表示方向

embodied.title: Making Future-Predictive Representations Actionable
embodied.abstract: Recent world action models (WAMs) drop future prediction at inference, assuming that representations learned through auxiliary future supervision still benefit action generation. However, our layerwise analysis of Fast-WAM reveals a depth-dependent mismatch: while probes decode future state transitions more accurately from deeper visual layers, the gradients and visual focuses of the future and action objectives increasingly diverge with depth, leaving much of this predictive information unused by the action pathway. To address this issue, we introduce RelayWAM, which adds an explicit transition space between the video and action backbones. Conditioned on the task instruction, robot state, and current action estimate, recurrent transition layers extract step-relevant predictive cues across depth and relay them directly into the action attention, without generating future frames at inference. Experiments show that RelayWAM substantially amplifies the benefit of future supervision, translating into stronger generalization under distribution shifts in both simulation and real-world robot tasks. On LIBERO-Plus, RelayWAM achieves 72.03% mean success, compared to 56.42% without future supervision and 51.50% for Fast-WAM.
embodied.comment: 15 pages, 6 main figures, including supplementary material
embodied.titleZh: 让未来预测表征可被动作利用
embodied.summaryZh: 世界动作模型（WAM）在推理时丢弃未来预测，默认辅助未来监督学到的表征仍能帮助动作生成；对 Fast-WAM 的逐层分析显示存在深度相关错配：越深的视觉层越能准确解码未来状态转移，但未来目标与动作目标的梯度及视觉关注点随深度加剧分离，大量预测信息未被动作通路使用。RelayWAM 在视频骨干与动作骨干之间插入显式转移空间，以任务指令、机器人状态和当前动作估计为条件，用循环转移层跨深度提取与当前步相关的预测线索并直接送入动作注意力，推理阶段不生成未来帧。在 LIBERO-Plus 上平均成功率达 72.03%，显著高于无未来监督的 56.42% 与 Fast-WAM 的 51.50%，并在仿真与真机任务的分布偏移下表现出更强泛化。
embodied.reason: WAM 结构与训练机制改进，兼有逐层分析与真机验证

embodied.title: Outcome-Balanced PPO and Policy-Induced Flow Rectification for Flow-Based VLA Policies
embodied.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables post-training of flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies by optimizing expected task return through environment interaction. However, this optimization raises two challenges: policy updates can alter the velocity-field geometry underlying the score approximation used for stochastic transitions, and sparse multi-task rollouts can yield uneven learning signals across tasks and advantage signs. We introduce an RL framework that combines Outcome-Balanced Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with policy-induced flow rectification. Outcome-Balanced PPO reweights positive advantages using task success-rate estimates and rescales positive and negative advantages while preserving their signs. Policy-induced rectification periodically fits a linear-bridge flow to ODE endpoint pairs generated by the current policy, refreshing the representation used in subsequent stochastic optimization. We evaluate the framework on simulated manipulation benchmarks and additionally study a component combination in a Real2Sim2Real task, examining task performance, optimization behavior, and flow consistency. The proposed framework improves success rates over the evaluated baselines across the simulated benchmarks.
embodied.titleZh: 面向基于流的VLA策略的结果均衡PPO与策略诱导流校正
embodied.summaryZh: 针对基于流的VLA策略在强化学习后训练中速度场几何随策略更新漂移、稀疏多任务rollout的学习信号不均衡两类问题，提出结果均衡PPO与策略诱导流校正相结合的框架。结果均衡PPO利用任务成功率估计重加权正优势，并在保持符号的前提下缩放正负优势；流校正则周期性用当前策略生成的ODE端点对拟合线性桥流，刷新后续随机优化所用的表示。在仿真操作基准上成功率超过所评估基线，并在Real2Sim2Real任务中考察组件组合、优化行为与流一致性。
embodied.reason: VLA后训练RL改进，直接命中具身VLA方向

embodied.title: Body Schema Policy: Body as the Vision-Action Interface for Efficient Robot Loco-Manipulation
embodied.abstract: Currently, robots can learn whole-body loco-manipulation through scale: the strongest policies have billions of parameters and still need task-specific fine-tuning. Humans have limited processing capacity, yet learn and act efficiently through a body schema that organizes what they see and how they move. We introduce Body Schema Policy (BSP), an imitation learning policy that builds such a schema into the vision-action interface. Its latent body schema places joint and link tokens on the robot's kinematic tree, where learned screw motions carry features between links. Through body-queried vision, each body part retrieves its own visual evidence, which conditions the denoising of its actions. With this inductive bias, BSP returns an action chunk faster than any policy we compare. Compact, body-specific visual readouts also emerge without spatial supervision: manipulation commands depend strongly on task objects, while locomotion commands respond more broadly to the scene. On nine simulated Unitree G1 whole-body tasks, BSP matches the $Ψ_0$ humanoid foundation model with $75\times$ fewer parameters and nearly doubles Diffusion Policy's success. The same holds on a real G1 and a Fetch mobile manipulator.
embodied.titleZh: Body Schema Policy:以身体作为视觉-动作接口的高效机器人移动操作策略
embodied.summaryZh: 全身移动操作策略目前依赖规模堆叠，最强模型达数十亿参数且仍需任务特定微调。BSP 把「身体图式」嵌入视觉-动作接口:潜空间身体图式将关节与连杆 token 置于运动学树上，以可学习的螺旋运动在连杆间传递特征;身体查询式视觉让每个身体部位检索自身的视觉证据，并以此条件化其动作去噪。由此归纳偏置，BSP 生成动作块的速度快于所有对比策略，且无需空间监督即涌现紧凑的部位专属视觉读出(操作指令强依赖任务物体，移动指令更响应整体场景)。在九项 Unitree G1 仿真全身任务上，以少 75 倍的参数量比肩 Ψ0 人形基础模型，成功率约为 Diffusion Policy 的两倍，并在真实 G1 与 Fetch 移动操作平台上复现。
embodied.reason: 身体图式作为视觉-动作接口，参数效率显著，属具身基础模型扎实工作

embodied.title: Similar Is Not Useful: Selecting In-Context Demonstrations by Closed-Loop Utility
embodied.abstract: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) policies fill their context with the demonstrations whose frames look most like the current observation under frozen DINOv2 embeddings. We ask whether visual similarity selects the demonstrations that make the policy succeed. For a frozen retrieval-augmented VLA (RICL on $π_0$-FAST, LIBERO), we make the demonstration pool swappable at run time and score each demonstration's utility by regressing the closed-loop success of 60 fixed-size pools on their membership. On initial states disjoint from those used for scoring, pools of the five highest-utility demonstrations succeed on 66.4% of 760 paired episodes across 19 tasks, pools of the five most similar on 55.7%, and random pools on 55.5%. Utility beats similarity by 10.8 points ($p=3.2\times10^{-6}$; positive on 15 of 18 untied tasks), including on 12 tasks the policy was never primed on, and similarity-selected pools do no better than random ($+0.1$ points). Within a task, a pool's visual similarity to the test scenes tracks its success at Spearman 0.10; across tasks, similarity separates tasks whose scenes differ and falls to chance when two tasks share a scene. The gain comes from on-task closed-loop evidence: best-of-ten direct search over pools recovers two-thirds of it with 100 rollouts. Against the shipped 20-demonstration pool, utility-curated pools of five lead by 7.0 points over 560 paired episodes from two evaluation runs ($p=0.006$), and utility-ordered retrieval inside the full pool leads by 4.5 points ($p=0.055$).
embodied.titleZh: 相似并不有用：通过闭环效用选择上下文演示
embodied.summaryZh: 检索增强的VLA策略通常按冻结DINOv2特征的视觉相似度挑选上下文演示，但相似是否等于有用缺乏验证。作者在RICL+π0-FAST（LIBERO）上把演示池改为运行时可替换，用60个固定大小池的闭环成功率回归出每个演示的效用分数。在未参与打分的初始状态上，五个最高效用演示组成的池在19个任务760个配对回合中成功率为66.4%，最高相似度池为55.7%，随机池为55.5%，效用比相似度高10.8个百分点（p=3.2×10⁻⁶），而相似度选择与随机无异；相对官方20演示池，五个效用筛选演示领先7.0个百分点。结果说明上下文演示应按闭环效用而非视觉相似度选取，可直接用于VLA的检索与上下文构建。
embodied.reason: VLA上下文演示选择与闭环效用评估，方法清晰且直接命中VLA后训练方向
